name: insitu-sales
description: inSitu Sales enables manufacturers, wholesalers, and distributors to work with field sales, direct-store delivery, warehouse operations, inventory, customers, orders, invoices, products, and B2B e-commerce data directly from your AI agents. Users authenticate with their existing inSitu Sales credentials, so each organization accesses only its authorized business data and workflows.
